channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran sets terms for peace; Saudi forces foil Riyadh attack
item.description: Iran security chief says Tehran's demands include an end to war on all fronts and the lifting of US's naval blockade.

item.title: Turkiye backs Saudi Arabia’s security amid escalating Houthi attacks: FM
item.description: Turkish FM highlights Turkiye's readiness to assist Saudi Arabia militarily, as Houthi attacks intensify in Yemen.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says defences intercept Houthi missile fired at Riyadh
item.description: It was the first air raid alert in Riyadh since an escalation in fighting between the Houthis in Yemen and Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Israel’s president pardons soldier who killed wounded Palestinian in 2016
item.description: Elor Azaria had shot a Palestinian who had already been incapacitated by Israeli troops, in controversial case.

item.title: Hegseth kicks off ‘Send Me Tour’ amid Iran war backlash
item.description: US Secretary of Defence Pete Hegseth has kicked off his ‘Send Me Tour’ in Texas amid Iran war backlash.

item.title: Iran says conditions to re-engage in talks, end war sent to US via Qatar
item.description: Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, tells Al Jazeera Tehran awaiting Trump response.

item.title: Israel targets paramedics in southern Lebanon
item.description: Two back-to-back Israeli air strikes hit Nabatieh in Lebanon, while a third strike targeted an ambulance team.

item.title: Syria says blast at military site in Deir Az Zor killed 11
item.description: Syrian army holds funeral for soldiers killed in ammunition blast in town of Ayyash, in western Deir Az Zor, on Friday.

item.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
item.description: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

item.title: Grim discoveries of murdered women spark fear in South Africa
item.description: Dineo Motapane is one of nine recent victims whose deaths have left a nation traumatised over the level of violence against women.
